name: Scope Support to Work
description: A free UK online and telephone employment-support programme from Scope for disabled people who are looking for paid work.
intended_use: Get structured employment support when looking for paid work, including contact with a specialist employment adviser.
audience_or_context: Disabled people aged 16 or over in the United Kingdom who are looking for paid work and can use internet, email and telephone support.
limitations: The service has eligibility and communication requirements that should be checked on the current Scope page.
Availability and delivery format can change, and the listing does not establish that the programme will lead to employment for an individual.
cost_or_access_notes: Scope currently describes Support to Work as a free programme.
conflicts_of_interest: The service is described from Scope's own current programme page; this establishes the route and stated eligibility, not independent evidence of employment outcomes.

provenance.method: Scope Support to Work official programme page checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records current UK eligibility and access conditions without converting first-party programme descriptions into effectiveness claims.
